Eastward selection checked for 3,584 location/ticket-byte cases; complete purchase tested with one through nine owned dollars. No independent listing sample.

Popcorn dollar-payment branch: one description, checked with one through nine owned dollars and every purchase flag (2,304 cases). Three reply streams checked with the original parser. No independent listing sample.

54 opening text records ($9816-$A3D6): generated descriptions from decoded streams, all 54 compared with the original parser.
